title: Relationship Credit Note: Operating Line Credit on the Equipment & Vehicle Loans Deferral Fee
content:
**Note.** An Equipment & Vehicle Loans deferral fee carries an operating-credit credit, the crop year of the grant date being its calendar year: 50.00 is taken off when the member holds an operating line in active status renewed for that crop year; 25.00 is taken off when the member holds an operating line in active status but none renewed for that crop year; and nothing when the member holds no operating line in active status. The credit is taken off the deferral fee after every multiplication of the fee has been made; the total is rounded once to cents and is never less than zero.

## Records it rests on

The member's Operating Lines of Credit: each line's status and the crop year for which it is booked or renewed.

## Credit by combination (grant in calendar year 2026, so crop year 2026)

| Operating line in active status | An active line renewed for crop year 2026 | Amount (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | -50.00 |
| yes | no (active lines are for another crop year) | -25.00 |
| no | — | 0 |

## Points of judgement

- The crop year compared is the calendar year of the grant date: a deferral granted on 3 January 2027 looks for an active line renewed for crop year 2027.
- A suspended or matured line is not in active status and earns no credit.
- Hypothetical: a fee of 150.00 with an active line renewed for the grant's crop year becomes 100.00; a fee of 30.00 with the same credit would fall below zero and is held at 0.00.
